name: ak:agentize
overview: Convert a codebase, feature, or module into an AI-agent-friendly CLI and/or MCP server. Covers npm packaging, stdio/SSE/Streamable HTTP surfaces, credential resolution, docs, tests, CI, and a companion Claude skill for users who need an existing capability exposed as a reusable agent tool.
whenToUse: Invoke to expose existing code as a reusable CLI or MCP tool.

flags.name: --auto
flags.desc: - Choose `--both` unless a clear signal says otherwise (e.g., browser-only code → skip CLI; no side-effect-free ops → skip MCP).

flags.name: --ask
flags.desc: after analysis, challenge the user with clarifying questions before implementing

flags.name: --version
flags.desc: `--json` for machine-readable output on every command
